name: Schmersal Inc.
old_description: Schmersal is a manufacturer of safety-related switchgear and control components. Products include wireless safety switches and industrial safety systems used in factory automation and material handling applications.
about:
Schmersal Inc., headquartered in Hawthorne, New York, is the U.S. arm of the Schmersal Group, a family-owned enterprise founded in 1945 in Germany. The company operates as an owner-managed Mittelstand firm with global reach, producing safety switching devices and systems for machine guarding and occupational safety.

The company manufactures a broad portfolio of safety-related switchgear and control components, including safety switches with separate actuators, safety interlocks, non-contact safety sensors (light curtains, grids, and barriers), safety relay modules, programmable safety controllers, and ATEX-certified explosion-proof switches. It also supplies elevator technology components and offers the tec.nicum service division for manufacturer-neutral safety consulting, training, and lean production support. Global headcount exceeds 1,000 employees.

Schmersal serves machine builders, system integrators, and plant operators across industrial automation, general manufacturing, material handling, factory automation, and explosion-hazard environments. Its safety systems are deployed in applications ranging from guard-door monitoring and emergency-stop circuits to complex safety-related control architectures for automated production lines and elevators.

The firm emphasizes its “complete solutions from a single source” approach—combining components, control systems, and software into tailored safety concepts—and cites the flexibility of a family-owned mid-sized company paired with the international presence of a corporation as a key differentiator. It also claims to offer the world’s largest range of safety switches and safety systems.
